notes: Trigger-coverage eval suite for the v1.8.1 description trim. Positives are natural-language prompts a user would type in the situations the skill exists for. Negatives are prompts drawn from SIBLING skills in this same plugin, so the score measures separation from close neighbours, not just recall. Word-overlap scoring is blind to trigger-condition NARROWING -- run check_skill_descriptions.py --compare for that.
